limits: This is a derived summary, not raw evidence.
Host endpoints, host paths, process numbers and raw session/device identities are omitted; aliases and content hashes retain traceability.
Four cases use unchanged official-source overlays; these are separate from stock frozen Unit API results.
The generic harness has open review guards; these five retained receipts were independently checked and did not trigger those gaps.
No physical RF, electrical, optical, acoustic or mechanical validation; no full API or cross-host coverage claim.
